facts.fact: The national Open Data steering committee (COPIL), meeting at the Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD), debated a 2026 action plan of the government's Open Data programme that includes enriching and maintaining the national open data portal www.data.gov.ma; the document names no open data policy, strategy or law behind the portal and gives no dataset or publisher count.
